definitions.gloss: to consult; to confer with; to refer to
definitions.explanation: To formally seek advice or a decision from a council, committee, or advisory body. Used in official, organizational, and governmental contexts.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}に{諮|はか}る。
この{件|けん}は{審議会|しんぎかい}に{諮|はか}る{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: This matter needs to be referred to the advisory council.

examples.japanese: {市長|しちょう}は{予算案|よさんあん}を{議会|ぎかい}に{諮|はか}ってから{最終|さいしゅう}{決定|けってい}を{下|くだ}した。
examples.english: The mayor made the final decision after referring the budget proposal to the assembly.

notes:
A formal verb used in bureaucratic and organizational contexts. The pattern is always ～に{諮|はか}る, where に marks the body being consulted.

Do not confuse with other はかる verbs:
- {測|はか}る (to measure)
- {図|はか}る (to plan; to attempt)
- {計|はか}る (to calculate; to time)
- {量|はか}る (to weigh)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {委員会|いいんかい}に{諮|はか}る (to consult a committee)
- {審議会|しんぎかい}に{諮|はか}る (to refer to an advisory council)
- {議会|ぎかい}に{諮|はか}る (to bring before the assembly)

RELATED WORD:
{諮問|しもん} (formal consultation/inquiry) is the noun form of the same concept.
